content: <thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 179.0946, which is most likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈178.087 Da. The formula that matches this mass within typical high‑resolution error is C₉H₁₀N₂O₂ (exact mass 178.074 Da, within a few ppm of the observed value). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C9H10N2O2.
